import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = new tencentcloud.tdmq.RocketmqCluster("example", {
    clusterName: "tf_example",
    remark: "remark.",
});
const exampleRocketmqNamespace = new tencentcloud.tdmq.RocketmqNamespace("example", {
    clusterId: example.clusterId,
    namespaceName: "tf_example",
    remark: "remark.",
});
const exampleRocketmqGroup = new tencentcloud.tdmq.RocketmqGroup("example", {
    groupName: "tf_example",
    clusterId: example.clusterId,
    namespace: exampleRocketmqNamespace.namespaceName,
    readEnable: true,
    broadcastEnable: true,
    remark: "remark.",
});

## Import



tdmqRocketmq group can be imported using the id, e.g.
```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Tdmq/rocketmqGroup:RocketmqGroup group group_id
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
